svg.title: Nanga Parbat — mountain relief
svg.desc: Western Diamir face. Vast Diamir amphitheatre, upper snow basin, Mummery Spur and summit headwall. Layered vector contour adaptation of a photograph by Clara Kulich. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nanga_Parbat_Diamir_face.jpg. License: CC BY-SA 2.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Changes: sky removed, cropped, tonal contours traced, blue and white palette.
